STATUS

Source: STATUS.md

Last updated: 2026-11-15 (PR #66 merged; release prep on main)

Where things stand

  • On CRAN: 1.0.5 (submitted 2026-04-21; tag v1.0.5, SHA 7a04d4f).
  • Development: dev at 1.0.5.9002. refactor/sc-step-unify and origin/dev point to the same commit. The work since 1.0.5 (see NEWS.md):
    • unified sc-step C++ kernels;
    • truncation options split into reporting (report_first_K, report_last_K) and generation conditioning (generate_at_least_K, generate_at_most_K), with the doubly-truncated Poisson primitive rbtpois;
    • atmostB renamed to budget_cap (atmostB is kept as a deprecated alias that warns);
    • long-format event output (output = "long");
    • new vignettes (writing intensity functions, long vs dense output).
  • Verified 2026-11-15 on dev (f181746), local macOS: R CMD check --as-cran gave 0 errors, 0 warnings, 0 notes. testthat: 1557 pass, 0 fail, 0 skip. Vignettes rebuild.
  • Sanitizers (R-hub, 2026-08-27, commit 681cf1f): clang-ASan and gcc-ASan clean. The valgrind job fails on a small leak in the rstream dependency, not in nhppp code. This run predates 16 commits that changed about 190 lines in src/ (the long-output path).
  • Reverse dependencies: none on CRAN (checked 2026-11-15).

Release checklist for 1.1.0 (tracked in GitHub issue #65)

Open items / notes

  • The valgrind “failure” will recur on R-hub until rstream fixes the leak. Mention it in cran-comments.md if CRAN’s valgrind check reports it.
